title: Letter Rack Clusters
brief: A word game server receives the words players submit and wants to cluster together submissions that were built from the same set of letter tiles, just arranged differently.

Implement clusterByLetters(strs), where strs is the list of submitted words, and return a list of clusters, each a list of words, so that two words share a cluster exactly when one is a rearrangement of the other's letters.
